answer.evidence: The sorting logic is in radon/complexity.py. Lines 10-12 define the ordering keys: SCORE = lambda block: -GET_COMPLEXITY(block), LINES = lambda block: block.lineno, ALPHA = lambda block: block.name. Line 59 defines sorted_results(blocks, order=SCORE), and line 75 returns sorted(blocks, key=order). The docstring at lines 69-73 says SCORE is the default and sorts descending. radon/visitors.py:200 says its returned list is not sorted, so it only supplies the blocks. A grep of raw.py and metrics.py found no sorting code. As asked, I gave the pair absent from required_memory_refs (A and C, 40 minutes combined) the most time. They would be checked for any sort or ordering use and for how they consume sorted blocks. Source evidence suggests B is the real target, so B is the primary file. If the review is only about ordering, the 40 minutes on A and C is probably more than needed.
